name: stoky-matrix
description: Research Stoky's temporal market knowledge graph with lossless first-class citations.

interface.shortDescription: Cited temporal market research from Stoky Matrix
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Stoky's read-only Matrix knowledge graph by signing in with a Stoky Pro account. Research entities and relationships, inspect point-in-time snapshots and diffs, read the linear event stream, and preserve citation IDs with lossless evidence records.
defaultPrompt: Research a company in Matrix and cite every material claim.
Compare what Matrix knew about a topic on two dates.
Trace recent events through Matrix and assess the evidence.
